item.title: Job 30: Faith in the Darkness of Suffering
item.description: In Job 30, Job moves from honor to humiliation and gives voice to deep suffering. This episode shows how biblical lament is not unbelief, but faith honestly brought before God, pointing us to Jesus Christ, the Man of Sorrows.

item.title: Created Male and Female, God’s Good Design
item.description: In this opening message of the Marriage and Family series, Dave Jenkins explores Genesis 1–2 to show how God created humanity male and female, why identity begins with the Creator, and how the gospel restores God’s good design.
